insights.finding_title: Stage 10 rounds 390–420 cleared three major self-tuning PID milestones: raw 12×5 beat PID for the first time (48.7 → 48.8 vs. 48.6), moving-average 12×5 reached 48.3 (only 0.3 behind PID) with non-level EMA beating PID four straight times (52.2–52.5 vs. 52.2), and 24×10 hit a new all-time high of 60.6 (+7.6 above PID).
insights.finding: Four-fifths through its 16-hour schedule (13.17 h, round 428 live at 73–91 s/row, zero allocation retries, zero bad samples), Stage 10 locked four consecutive 12×5 evaluations in 48.0–48.3 EMA while setting records across every scale: round 340 pushed 48×20 to a new all-time high of 66.3 (+10.1 above self-tuning PID 56.2); round 390 lifted 12×5 EMA to a new record 48.3 (raw 48.7, first time beating PID 48.6 on full 12×5), pushed non-level EMA past PID for the first time at 52.5 (raw 52.8), lifted post-event recovery to a record 51.1, drove violations to a record-low 34.3% and reversals to 31.2%, and pushed 24×10 to 60.5; round 400 lifted raw 12×5 further to 48.8 (raw non-level 53.2, +1.0 above PID), hit hidden-pairing records of 22.1 EMA / 22.7 raw, and pushed 24×10 to an all-time high of 60.6 (+7.6 above PID); rounds 410–420 held 48.0 EMA (non-level 52.2–52.5, round-420 pre-event record 42.1, 24×10 59.7–59.8, 48×20 65.0–65.4).
insights.bottleneck_title: With ~2.8 hours (~100 rounds) left in the cosine cooldown (learning rate 1.0e-5), Stage 10 beats self-tuning PID on 48×20 (+10.1), 24×10 (+7.6), 12×5 non-level EMA (+0.3), and 12×5 raw (+0.2), sitting just 0.3 points below PID on 12×5 EMA (48.3 vs. 48.6).
insights.bottleneck: The final 0.3-point EMA gap on 12×5 sits in integrating-level edge cases (40.8 vs. PID 42.0) and extreme 45+-step dead-time loops; the upgraded cloud+local hybrid training pipeline (3× faster local GPU throughput, zero-credit async validation, and hard-case curriculum) is finishing live end-to-end verification ahead of Stage 11.

insights.next: Once Stage 10 finishes (or 12×5 EMA clears 48.6), run a fresh exact 8-family zero-shot mechanistic industrial exam, regenerate all four dynamic replays, and publish updated open weights across GitHub, Hugging Face, and ModelScope.

Switched live on the 96 GB GPU to Stage 7, introducing the dead-time Smith-predictor privileged critic (256-step four-head), sharper dead-band cost alignment, and reversal-only anti-chatter smoothing.
timeline.text_zh: 第六阶段完成第 140–150 轮（5.9 小时、1,797 次更新），将 48×20 推至 62.0 分（不带液位首次突破 80 达 80.3 分）、24×10 推至 54.4 分，同时确认 12×5 连续 11 次验证停滞在 38.5–40.0 分。现已在现役 GPU 无缝切入第七阶段，上线纯滞后 Smith 预测器风格的特权价值网络（256 步四头预测）、更贴合带宽考核的目标函数以及反向防抖平滑。

timeline.text: Stage 6 rounds 110–130 (5.1 h): 24×10 broke 54 for the first time at 54.6 (above self-tuning PID 53.0), 48×20 hit its lowest constraint violation rate yet (11.5%), and 12×5 levels reached 33.6. Controlled offline A/B tests proved that feeding exact delay-pipeline and Smith-predictor features into the privileged critic more than doubles gradient alignment (2.4×) on unseen long-delay plants.
timeline.text_zh: 第六阶段第 110–130 轮（5.1 小时）：24×10 历史首破 54 达 54.6 分（领先自整定PID 53.0 分），48×20 越限占比降至 11.5% 新低，12×5 带液位升至 33.6 分。离线受控对照实验证实，向特权价值网络输入延迟管道在途动作与 Smith 预测器终态特征，可将未见大纯滞后装置的梯度对齐度提高到原来的 2.4 倍。

timeline.text: Stage 6 round 90 (3.5 h): 48×20 broke 61 for the first time at 61.1 (+4.9 points above self-tuning PID 56.2), hidden-pairing held at 2.4, and raw 12×5 weights (39.3) surpassed EMA weights (39.1) across every sub-metric as cosine learning-rate decay took effect.
timeline.text_zh: 第六阶段第 90 轮（3.5 小时）：48×20 历史首次突破 61 达 61.1 分（领先自整定PID 56.2 分达 4.9 分），不告知配对稳在 2.4 分；随着余弦学习率退火生效，12×5 实时权重（39.3 分）全子项反超平均权重（39.1 分）。

timeline.text_zh: 第六阶段第 80 轮（3.1 小时）全尺寸带液位装置创历史新高：12×5 带液位首破 33 达 33.5 分（较本阶段起点涨 4.3 分），48×20 带液位达 50.7 分（合计 60.2 分），24×10 带液位稳在 53.7 分。

timeline.text_zh: 用第六阶段第 40 轮权重（未训练机理装置）刷新第 03 节全部四组动态回放：零样本 TEP 从 −110.6 分跃升至 +63.0 分，零样本 BSM1 污水处理达 +92.8 分，典型四阀随机装置从 −34.2 分升至 +77.2 分，串级液位装置从 −65.5 分改善至 −27.4 分。

timeline.text: Stage 6 rounds 50–60 (2.3 h): hidden-pairing control broke 3 points for the first time (3.2), 48×20 held above 60 twice in a row (60.2, non-level peak 79.1), and a 64-plant audit confirmed the upper quartile jumped +9.4 points (52.7 → 62.1) with global under-driving solved.
timeline.text_zh: 第六阶段第 50–60 轮（2.3 小时）：不告知配对工况历史首次突破 3 分达 3.2 分，48×20 连续两次站稳 60.2 分（不带液位峰值 79.1 分）；64 台对照剖析证实上四分位成绩大涨 9.4 分（52.7 → 62.1），此前普遍动作偏小的问题已解决。

timeline.text: Stage 6 round 40 (1.5 h, 477 updates) reached 40.0 on 12×5 (+2.9 points in 1.5 h): levels 32.8, non-level 44.0, post-event 41.9, hidden-pairing crossed 2 for the first time (2.1), and 24×10 levels hit 54.6 (overall 53.2, surpassing self-tuning PID 53.0).
timeline.text_zh: 第六阶段第 40 轮（1.5 小时、477 次更新）在 12×5 触及 40.0 分（1.5 小时净涨 2.9 分）：带液位 32.8 分、不带液位 44.0 分、事件后 41.9 分、不告知配对首破 2 达 2.1 分；24×10 带液位升至 54.6 分，综合分达 53.2 超过自整定PID（53.0）。

timeline.text: Stage 6 rounds 20–30 (1.1 h) broke records across every size: 12×5 climbed +1.8 points to 38.9 (levels 31.8, non-level 42.8, post-event first over 40 at 40.4), 48×20 broke 60 for the first time at 60.3 (self-tuning PID 56.2), and 24×10 held 53.1.
timeline.text_zh: 第六阶段第 20–30 轮（1.1 小时）全线刷新纪录：12×5 较本阶段起点大涨 1.8 分至 38.9 分（带液位 31.8 分、不带液位 42.8 分、事件后首破 40 达 40.4 分），48×20 首次突破 60 达 60.3 分（领先自整定PID 56.2 分），24×10 稳在 53.1 分。

timeline.text: Stage 6 round 10 (just 20 min, 117 updates) set four all-time highs: 24×10 jumped +1.4 points to 53.4 (first time past self-tuning PID 53.0), hidden-pairing reached 1.6, 12×5 non-level reached 41.5, and 48×20 reached 59.7.
timeline.text_zh: 第六阶段第 10 轮（仅跑 20 分钟、117 次更新）连创四项新高：24×10 猛涨 1.4 分达 53.4 分（首次超越自整定PID 参照 53.0 分），不告知配对升至 1.6 分，12×5 不带液位达 41.5 分，48×20 升至 59.7 分。

timeline.text: Offline analysis of Stage 5 on 64 plants showed excessive move smoothing was under-driving 85% of normal plants and a constant learning rate was capping 12×5 at 37.4. Switched live to Stage 6 with cosine learning-rate decay, 6× lighter smoothing, and a 5× larger batch size.
timeline.text_zh: 对第五阶段做 64 台离线排查发现：过重的动作平滑惩罚导致 85% 常规装置动作幅度偏小，且恒定学习率把 12×5 卡在 37.4 分。现已无缝切入第六阶段：启用 16 小时余弦学习率退火、把平滑惩罚降至原来的六分之一，并将并行批次扩至 5 倍。

timeline.text: Stage 5 round 150 (5.8 h, 1,796 updates): hidden-pairing control crossed +1 for the first time (1.2), 12×5 non-level hit 41.4, and 48×20 held 59.6; five straight evaluations in the 37.1–37.4 range confirmed the constant learning rate had reached its noise floor.
timeline.text_zh: 第五阶段第 150 轮（5.8 小时、1,796 次更新）：不告知配对首次突破 +1 达 1.2 分，12×5 不带液位达 41.4 分，48×20 稳在 59.6 分；12×5 连续五次盘整在 37.1–37.4 分，确认恒定学习率已触及方差下限，准备切换余弦退火。

timeline.text: Stage 5 rounds 130–140 (5.4 h) set three new highs: 48×20 reached 59.7 (levels 49.9), 24×10 reached 52.4 (levels 53.7), and hidden-pairing scored positive twice in a row (0.7).
timeline.text_zh: 第五阶段第 130–140 轮（5.4 小时）再刷三项新高：48×20 升至 59.7 分（带液位 49.9 分），24×10 升至 52.4 分（带液位 53.7 分），不告知配对连续两轮为正创 0.7 分新高。

timeline.text_zh: 第五阶段第 120 轮（4.6 小时）大尺寸装置再破纪录：48×20 冲至 59.1 分（较起点暴涨 16.1 分，领先自整定PID 56.2 分），24×10 达 52.0 分，12×5 稳在 37.1 分。

timeline.text: Stage 5 round 110 (4.2 h) jumped +1.2 points in 23 minutes to 37.4 overall (+6.4 points from stage start), crossing 30 on 12×5 level plants (30.3) and 41 on non-level plants (41.3) for the first time while cutting constraint violations.
timeline.text_zh: 第五阶段第 110 轮（4.2 小时）23 分钟内猛涨 1.2 分至 37.4 分（较本阶段起点涨 6.4 分），12×5 带液位首次破 30（30.3 分）、不带液位首次破 41（41.3 分），约束越限率继续下降。

timeline.text: Stage 5 rounds 90–100 (3.8 h, 3.57M steps) set highs across every batch: 12×5 36.2 (levels 29.6, non-level 39.8), 24×10 51.2, and 48×20 58.1 (+15.1 points from stage start, ahead of self-tuning PID 56.2).
timeline.text_zh: 第五阶段第 90–100 轮（3.8 小时、357 万步）全线刷新纪录：12×5 达 36.2 分（带液位 29.6、不带液位 39.8），24×10 达 51.2 分，48×20 达 58.1 分（较本阶段起点大涨 15.1 分，已超自整定PID 56.2 分）。

timeline.text: Stage 5 round 80 (3.0 h): hidden-pairing control turned positive (+0.5, up +7.4 points from −7.0) for the first time in the project, and 24×10 level plants reached a new high of 52.1.
timeline.text_zh: 第五阶段第 80 轮（3.0 小时）：不告知配对工况历史首次转正（+0.5 分，较起点 −7.0 净涨 7.4 分），24×10 带液位创 52.1 分新高。

timeline.text_zh: 第五阶段第 50–70 轮（2.7 小时）连跨三大台阶：12×5 升至 35.4 分，24×10 首次破 50 达 51.0 分，48×20 冲上 57.2 分（历史上首次超过同批自整定PID 的 56.2 分）。

timeline.text: Stage 5 round 40 (90 min) swept every benchmark again: 12×5 34.1 (levels 27.7, non-level 37.6), 24×10 47.2, 48×20 52.5, and hidden-pairing −2.8 (+4.2 points in 90 minutes).
timeline.text_zh: 第五阶段第 40 轮（90 分钟）全线再破新高：12×5 达 34.1 分（带液位 27.7、不带液位 37.6），24×10 达 47.2 分，48×20 达 52.5 分，不告知配对升至 −2.8 分（90 分钟净涨 4.2 分）。

timeline.text: Stage 5 round 30 (66 min) set four more highs: 24×10 46.6, 48×20 51.8, 12×5 levels 26.8 (overall 33.0), and hidden-pairing −3.2.
timeline.text_zh: 第五阶段第 30 轮（66 分钟）再刷四项新高：24×10 达 46.6 分、48×20 达 51.8 分、12×5 带液位达 26.8 分（综合 33.0 分）、不告知配对升至 −3.2 分。

timeline.text: Stage 5 round 20 (45 min) reached all-time highs on every metric: 12×5 33.2 (levels 26.2, non-level 37.1), 24×10 44.8, 48×20 50.9, and hidden-pairing −3.4 (+3.6 points in 45 min), with the fixed-horizon privileged critic reaching 75–80% explained variance.
timeline.text_zh: 第五阶段第 20 轮（45 分钟）全部指标再创新高：12×5 达 33.2 分（带液位 26.2、不带液位 37.1），24×10 达 44.8 分，48×20 达 50.9 分，不告知配对升至 −3.4 分（45 分钟涨 3.6 分）；定长特权价值网络解释方差升至 75–80%。

timeline.text: Stage 5 round 10 (19.5 min, 118 updates) broke every record: 12×5 32.4, 24×10 44.2, 48×20 crossed 50 for the first time (50.4), and hidden-pairing improved to −4.7; the fixed-horizon privileged critic stayed completely drift-free and enabled uniform learning across all 12 layers.
timeline.text_zh: 第五阶段第 10 轮（仅 19.5 分钟、118 次更新）全线破纪录：12×5 达 32.4 分、24×10 达 44.2 分、48×20 首次突破 50 达 50.4 分、不告知配对升至 −4.7 分；定长特权价值网络彻底消除自举漂移，全网 12 层首次实现均匀更新。

timeline.text: Stage 4 raised GPU utilization to 90% (5.5× sample throughput, 2.7× update speed) and lifted hidden-pairing to −5.0 within 20 minutes, while exposing temporal-difference self-amplification in the critic; switched immediately to Stage 5 with a time-invariant, fixed-horizon privileged critic.
timeline.text_zh: 第四阶段将 GPU 利用率拉升至 90%（样本吞吐提升 5.5 倍、更新提速 2.7 倍），20 分钟就把不告知配对刷新到 −5.0 分，同时定位出价值网络的时序差分自举发散问题；已立即切换为采用定长未来真实代价拟合的第五阶段。

timeline.text: Major training efficiency upgrade launched as Stage 4 on the 96 GB GPU (4× batch size): added layer-wise activation checkpointing, a training-only privileged value network reading true simulator states, hybrid Muon + AdamW optimization with higher learning rates for routing biases, and validation caching.
timeline.text_zh: 上线第四阶段重大提效升级（4 倍并行批次）：引入分层激活重算大幅省显存、新增读取仿真器内部真值的训练期特权价值网络、换用 Muon + AdamW 混合优化器并提高注意力路由偏置学习率，配合验证集缓存提速。

timeline.text: Stage 3 confirmed width-aware output scaling eliminated the severe −19-point validation drops in raw weights (EMA 30.9 vs. raw 30.8, new hidden-pairing high −5.3), while profiling showed low batch size and uneven layer gradients were the remaining speed bottleneck.
timeline.text_zh: 第三阶段证实宽度自适应输出缩放彻底根治了实时权重骤降 19 分的震荡问题（平均权重 30.9 vs 实时权重 30.8、不告知配对创新高 −5.3 分），同时剖析定位出小批次噪声与浅层垄断梯度是拖慢收敛的剩余主因。

timeline.text: Ablation checks on Stage 2 round 65 (31.0 peak, levels 25.6) proved the unscaled action readout head caused over 80% of raw-weight instability; transitioned seamlessly to Stage 3 with width-aware 1/√d output scaling and weight-decay-free delay biases.
timeline.text_zh: 对第二阶段第 65 轮（峰值 31.0 分、带液位 25.6 分）做消融排查证实，未做宽度缩放的动作输出头导致了八成以上的实时权重掉分；已无缝切入启用 1/√d 宽度缩放与滞后偏置免衰减的第三阶段。

timeline.text: Stage 2 broke 30 points at round 55 (2.5 h on Colab 96 GB GPU), setting new all-time highs on every validation batch: 12×5 30.4 (levels 23.0, non-level 34.6), 24×10 43.6, 48×20 49.1, and hidden-pairing −5.6.
timeline.text_zh: 第二阶段在第 55 轮（2.5 小时）突破 30 分，全部验证批同步刷新历史新高：12×5 达 30.4 分（带液位 23.0、不带液位 34.6），24×10 达 43.6 分，48×20 达 49.1 分，不告知配对升至 −5.6 分。

timeline.text: Stage 2 reached round 45 (2.4 h) with broad new highs—12×5 reaching 29.6 (levels 23.9) and 48×20 reaching 46.3—while spurious valve movement before the first event dropped tenfold.
timeline.text_zh: 第二阶段跑至第 45 轮（2.4 小时），多项刷新历史新高：12×5 峰值 29.6 分（带液位 23.9 分）、48×20 升至 46.3 分，同时静息无事件时的误动降为原来的十分之一。

timeline.text: Fixed six training, memory, and synchronization bugs (duplicate tail cost accounting, unused probe noise, cross-size gradient mixing, 9.6 GB memory leak, and oversized checkpoint syncing) and started Stage 2 on a 96 GB GPU continuing from Stage 1 round 732.
timeline.text_zh: 修复六处训练、显存与同步缺陷（末端代价重复计数、冗余试阀噪声、跨尺寸梯度混淆、9.6 GB 显存泄漏与存档同步冗余），承接第一阶段第 732 轮权重在 96 GB GPU 正式开启第二阶段纯真实代价训练。

timeline.text: Research paused; training stopped by hand at round 732 with the best score +28.3 (round 715), state saved for a later resume.
timeline.text_zh: 研究暂停；训练手动停在第 732 轮，最好成绩 +28.3（第 715 轮），状态已存好，以后可接着练。

timeline.text: +27.0 at round 655 and still rising; not told the valve map it is up from −9.6 to −6.4.
timeline.text_zh: 第 655 轮 +27.0，仍在涨；不告诉对应关系时从 −9.6 回升到 −6.4。

timeline.text: +25.2 at round 545, a new best at every part: plants with a level +17.6, the others +29.4, large plants about +41 to +42.
Training resumed on a new G4 and reached +22.7 at round 440; plants with a level +14.8, large plants +33 to +36.
timeline.text_zh: 在新的 G4 上续跑，第 440 轮 +22.7；带液位 +14.8，大尺寸 +33 到 +36。

timeline.text: At the 23-hour machine change no card came for 2.5 hours and nothing trained; the change now takes the next machine before stopping the old one.
timeline.text_zh: 满 23 小时换机时 2.5 小时没抢到卡，训练空转；换机已改成先抢到新机器再关旧的。

timeline.text: Checked for shortcuts and found none, but not told the valve map the model scores −11.4, and on median episodes its moves are 25–60% of the teacher's.
timeline.text_zh: 查过没有捷径，但不告诉对应关系时是 −11.4 分；中位回合里动作力度只有老师的 25–60%。

timeline.text: The from-scratch run turned positive, +6.3 at round 305 (level plants −0.4, others +10.0, large plants −10); it rose at every validation since round 190.
timeline.text_zh: 从零训练的分数转正，第 305 轮 +6.3（液位装置 −0.4，其余 +10.0，大尺寸 −10）；第 190 轮起每次验证都在涨。

timeline.text: The 116M network started training from scratch on the true cost alone, with no imitation and no auxiliary losses.
timeline.text_zh: 1.16 亿参数网络从零开训，只按真实代价，不模仿、不加辅助损失。

timeline.text: Training overhauled: four bugs that held back the 116M run fixed (gradient leaking past cuts, guard ratchet, smoothing under teacher lead, cache rebuilt every window); pairing and signs told by default, blind episodes may try their valves.
timeline.text_zh: 训练大修完成：修掉拖垮 1.16 亿网络的四个工程错误（截断漏梯度、护栏棘轮、老师代驾时仍罚平滑、每窗重建缓存）；默认告知配对和正反作用，不告知的回合可自己试阀。

timeline.text: 116M true-cost stage paused at round 187: −3.6 at round 180, still below holding the valves; training to be overhauled.
timeline.text_zh: 1.16 亿参数网络真实代价段停在第 187 轮：第 180 轮合计 −3.6，仍不如不动；暂停，准备大修训练。

timeline.text: True-cost stage of the 116M network, round 122 (after an out-of-range fix): the cost has not fallen, −5.2 at round 110 and −11.2 at round 120, and more steps are skipped.
timeline.text_zh: 1.16 亿参数网络真实代价段（修好越界后）到第 122 轮：代价没降，第 110 轮合计 −5.2、第 120 轮 −11.2，丢步变多。

timeline.text: The 116M network moves on to the true cost from round 100.
timeline.text_zh: 1.16 亿参数网络从第 100 轮起接真实代价训练。

timeline.text: The 116M imitation stage ended flat: −7.0 at round 100, no better since round 20; it reads its own valve within an episode (.38 vs 1.39 for a guess) but not which valve moves which reading.
timeline.text_zh: 1.16 亿参数网络模仿段 100 轮收平：第 100 轮合计 −7.0，20 轮后不再涨；回合内能读出自己那个阀的作用（.38，瞎猜 1.39），哪个阀管哪个读数没学到。

timeline.text: 116M network from scratch, round 10: −9.2 overall (−5.6 when told which valve moves which reading), barely moving the valves; it is learning to read its own valve, not yet which valve moves which reading.
timeline.text_zh: 1.16 亿参数网络从零第 10 轮：合计 −9.2（告诉它阀管哪个读数时 −5.6），几乎不动阀；自己那个阀的作用在学，哪个阀管哪个读数还没学到。

timeline.text: The 116M network starts from scratch with imitation plus reading labels (resumed at round 9).
timeline.text_zh: 1.16 亿参数网络从零开训：模仿 + 读数标签（21:22 从第 9 轮续训）。

timeline.text: Reading labels added to full training for 60 rounds did not help: the score stayed at 4.3 and, untold, the direction is still a guess. Next: pretrain the reading alone.
timeline.text_zh: 加读数标签练了 60 轮没见效：分数停在 4.3，不告诉时阀往哪边作用仍是瞎猜；下一步先专门练读数。

timeline.text: The cause is found: the network controls when told which valve moves which reading (40) and fails to read which way a valve acts; taught with a label alone it reads 93% right.
timeline.text_zh: 找到卡点：告诉它哪个阀管哪个读数时会控制（40 分），自己读不出阀往哪边作用；单拿标签练能读对 93%。

timeline.text: Half precision saves no memory on the true-cost step, so it is off.
timeline.text_zh: 半精度在真实代价这一步不省显存，已关。

timeline.text: The environment standard is now H4: seven frozen exam batches, adding 24×10, 48×20 and two mechanistic batches with their references; the mechanistic batches are not yet bit-identical across machines, so they are read on Colab G4 only.
timeline.text_zh: 环境标准升到 H4：考试批扩到七批，加进 24×10、48×20 和两批机理装置，参照随包；机理批还不能跨机器逐位一致，暂时只在 Colab G4 上读。

timeline.text: New direction started: an end-to-end attention network, imitating the oracle MPC first; a 30-round short run is on Colab.
timeline.text_zh: 新方向开跑：端到端注意力网络，先模仿 oracle MPC；Colab 上 30 轮短跑。

timeline.text: Training from scratch is stopped: the network structure and training method are being redesigned first.
timeline.text_zh: 从零正式训练叫停：先重新设计网络结构和训练方法。

sim_rl.text_zh: 已跑 13.17 小时（16 小时计划进度 82%，第 428 轮稳跑中，单轮 73–91 秒、零重试零坏样本）：第 340 轮 48×20 创 66.3 全历史新高（+10.1 超 PID）；第 390 轮 12×5 平均升至 48.3（距 PID 48.6 仅差 0.3 分）、实时 48.7 历史首超 PID，不带液位平均 52.5 首超 PID（52.2），事件后创 51.1 新高，越限率 34.3%、换向率 31.2% 齐创新低；第 400 轮 12×5 实时再涨至 48.8（不带液位实时 53.2），盲控创 22.1 / 实时 22.7 双新高，24×10 创 60.6 新高（+7.6 超 PID）；第 410–420 轮稳站平均 48.0（第 420 轮事件前创 42.1 新高）。
